backlog.title: Your savings account is losing you money

lines.text: Your savings account is quietly losing you money, and your bank will never tell you.
Inflation runs at around three percent a year. Most big bank savings accounts pay you less than half a percent.
That means every single year, the money just sitting there buys less than it did before.
A high yield savings account pays ten times more, same safety, same government protection, just a different bank.
Move it once. Stop losing money for doing nothing. Follow for the next one.
If you invest two hundred pounds a month starting today, here is what nobody shows you.
In year one, you've put in twenty four hundred, and interest has barely done anything.
By year twenty, you've put in forty eight thousand, but the account is worth over one hundred thousand.
That extra fifty thousand pounds, you didn't work for. Time did.
The only variable you control is starting today instead of next month. Follow for part two.

backlog.title: The credit score myth costing you thousands

lines.text: Closing your oldest credit card to simplify your wallet could be the most expensive clean up you ever do.
A big chunk of your credit score is just the average age of your accounts.
Close the old one, and that average drops overnight, and so does your score.
Lower score means worse rates on the next car loan or mortgage, sometimes worth thousands over the loan.
Keep it open, use it once a year, cut it up if you have to. Follow for more money traps.
